definition: A group of congenital conditions characterized by multiple joint contractures present at birth in two or more body areas, resulting primarily from decreased fetal movement in utero.

source.title: The range of publications on arthrogryposis multiplex congenita from 1995 to 2022—A scoping review
source.quote: Arthrogryposis multiplex congenita (AMC) is defined as "a group of congenital conditions characterized by joint contractures in two or more body areas."
